info.name: FusionAuth Api Key Identity Provider API

params.name: type
params.description: The type of the identity provider.

items.docs: Retrieves one or more identity provider for the given type. For types such as Google, Facebook, Twitter and LinkedIn, only a single  identity provider can exist. For types such as OpenID Connect and SAMLv2 more than one identity provider can be configured so this request  may return multiple identity providers.
Creates an identity provider. You can optionally specify an Id for the identity provider, if not provided one will be generated.

params.name: identityProviderId
params.description: The unique Id of the identity provider. Specify this value to reduce the links returned to those for a particular IdP.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Id of the user.

params.name: identityProviderUserId
params.description: The unique Id of the user in the 3rd party identity provider.

items.docs: Retrieve all Identity Provider users (links) for the user. Specify the optional identityProviderId to retrieve links for a particular IdP. OR Retrieve a single Identity Provider user (link).
Link an external user from a 3rd party identity provider to a FusionAuth user.

params.name: identityProviderId
params.description: The unique Id of the identity provider.

params.name: identityProviderUserId
params.description: The unique Id of the user in the 3rd party identity provider to unlink.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique Id of the FusionAuth user to unlink.

items.docs: Remove an existing link that has been made from a 3rd party identity provider to a FusionAuth user.

params.name: userId
params.description: The optional userId. When provided additional meta-data will be provided to identify how many links if any the user already has.

items.docs: Retrieve a pending identity provider link. This is useful to validate a pending link and retrieve meta-data about the identity provider link.
Handles login via third-parties including Social login, external OAuth and OpenID Connect, and other login systems.

params.name: domain
params.description: The domain or email address to lookup.

params.name: tenantId
params.description: If provided, the API searches for an identity provider scoped to the corresponding tenant that manages the requested domain. If no result is found, the API then searches for global identity providers.

items.docs: Retrieves the identity provider for the given domain and tenantId. A 200 response code indicates the domain is managed by a registered identity provider. A 404 indicates the domain is not managed. OR Retrieves any global identity providers for the given domain. A 200 response code indicates the domain is managed by a registered identity provider. A 404 indicates the domain is not managed.
Searches identity providers with the specified criteria and pagination.
Begins a login request for a 3rd party login that requires user interaction such as HYPR.

params.name: connectionTestId
params.description: The connection test id to retrieve results for.

items.docs: Retrieves the results for an identity provider connection test.
Begins an identity provider connection test.
Retrieves the identity provider for the given Id or all the identity providers if the Id is null.

params.name: identityProviderId
params.description: The Id of the identity provider. If not provided a secure random UUID will be generated.

items.docs: Creates an identity provider. You can optionally specify an Id for the identity provider, if not provided one will be generated.

params.name: identityProviderId
params.description: The Id of the identity provider to update.

items.docs: Updates the identity provider with the given Id.

params.name: identityProviderId
params.description: The Id of the identity provider to update.

items.docs: Updates, via PATCH, the identity provider with the given Id.

params.name: identityProviderId
params.description: The Id of the identity provider to delete.

items.docs: Deletes the identity provider for the given Id.
